text.en:
The penultimate paragraph of Section 15 of Presidential Decree No. 992 is hereby amended to
read as follows:
"The Republic of the Philippines hereby guarantees the payment by the Corporation of both the principal and
the interest on the bonds so issued, and shall pay such principal and interest in case the Corporation fails to do
so, and in order to make the payments so guaranteed, such items as may be necessary are hereby appropriated
out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated."

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 22nd day of September in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-six.
